parameters.content:
## SECTION W1 — WEBSITE LEADS
**Starts from:** POST /webhook/website-lead (n8n Header Auth)

Validate (name, phone E.164, optional e-mail, consent) -> clinic lookup (Agency Registry) -> find / create / update the LEADS row (+ consent) -> **answer the website only after the lead is stored** (200 ok / duplicate, 400 invalid, 404 unknown clinic, 500 = try again) -> staff alert through W12 (`new_lead_staff_alert`, send guard, idempotency key) and optional e-mail (Mailpit locally) -> Run_Log.

## W1 - Website lead intake
Form -> POST https://<your-domain>/webhook/website-lead with the header set in the credential "FlowHQ W1 Webhook Auth" (Header Auth: name X-Lead-Secret, a long random value).
Body (JSON): clinic_slug, name, phone, enquiry, page_url, utm_campaign, **consent_whatsapp** (checkbox: true / "on"), consent_email, email, consent_version (which consent text was shown), website (hidden honeypot: must be empty).
Answers: 200 {status ok|duplicate} - 400 {status invalid, error: missing name | invalid phone | invalid email | consent required} - 404 unknown clinic - 500 (Grist unavailable: the form may retry; a retry is a harmless duplicate).
FLOWHQ_W1_REQUIRE_CONSENT=false accepts forms without the checkbox but records "no consent given": W12 then sends that person no business-initiated template.
Staff are alerted on WhatsApp (owner_phone in the clinic's Settings; TEST_MODE sends to TEST_PHONE; quiet hours hold it) and, if FLOWHQ_ALERT_EMAIL_TO is set, by e-mail.

## SECTION W3 — SPEED TO LEAD
**Starts from:** Schedule: every 10 minutes

New leads waiting 30 min - 48 h -> guard (TEST_MODE / quiet hours) -> **W3 – Call W12** (`new_lead_staff_alert`, key W3:new_lead_staff_alert:<lead>) -> if handled: Escalated + Run_Log (ok / skipped / failed with the reason).

## W3 - Speed-to-lead
Every 10 minutes, for every ACTIVE clinic: finds leads still on Status = New that waited 30+ minutes and are not Escalated, runs the send guard and alerts the clinic OWNER through W12 (`new_lead_staff_alert`).
Escalated is ticked when W12 handled the alert (sent, uncertain or duplicate), so an unclear Meta answer never makes the alert repeat. A refused or invalid send is logged in Run_Log.

## SECTION W4 — BOOKING
**Starts from:** POST /webhook/cal?clinic=<slug> (Cal.com, HMAC-signed)

Verify the signature over the RAW body + replay window -> clinic lookup -> create / reschedule / cancel the Appointments row (+ LEADS) -> **answer** (401 / 422 / 404 / 200; 500 on a Grist failure) -> confirmation through W12 (`booking_confirmation`) -> Confirm_Sent + Run_Log.

## W4 - Booking sync (Cal.com -> Grist)
Cal.com webhook URL: https://<your-domain>/webhook/cal?clinic=<Clinic_Slug>   Secret: the same value as FLOWHQ_CAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET (min 16 characters). Triggers: Booking created / rescheduled / cancelled.
The signature is checked over the exact bytes Cal.com sent (Webhook option "Raw Body"): a wrong or missing signature gets 401 and no alert. Events older than FLOWHQ_CAL_MAX_AGE_HOURS (default 24) are refused (replay).
Add to the Cal.com event type: a REQUIRED phone question, and a sentence saying the booking lets the clinic message the person about it (a lead created by a booking records Consent_Source cal.com-booking).
The confirmation is sent after the Grist writes. Not sent: TEST_MODE (goes to TEST_PHONE), opted-out, quiet hours (logged in Run_Log; no automatic catch-up).

## SECTION W5 — REMINDERS
**Starts from:** Schedule: every 15 minutes

Booked appointments due for the 24 h / 2 h reminder -> guard -> **W5 – Call W12** (`reminder_24h` / `reminder_2h`, key W5:<template>:<booking>) -> if handled: R24_Sent / R2_Sent + Run_Log.

## W5 - Appointment reminders (24h and 2h)
Every 15 minutes, for every ACTIVE clinic: finds Booked appointments due a reminder, runs the send guard and sends `reminder_24h` / `reminder_2h` through W12.
R24_Sent / R2_Sent is set when W12 handled the message (sent, uncertain or duplicate). Rejected / invalid sends are logged in Run_Log; the next run tries again (a rejected message was never sent).

## SECTION W6 — FOLLOW UPS
**Starts from:** Schedule: daily 10:00 (workflow time zone Asia/Kolkata)

No-show rebook, day-2 follow-up, mark Lost (mark_lost is OFF) -> guard -> **W6 – Call W12** -> if handled: Rebook_Sent / Followup_Sent + Run_Log.

## W6 - Follow-ups (daily 10:00 India time)
For every ACTIVE clinic:
1. **No-show rebook** (`noshow_rebook`) - appointments marked No-show yesterday or the day before, no new booking.
2. **Day-2 follow-up** (`followup_day2`, needs Settings > booking_link) - one per open lead.
3. **Mark Lost** (mark_lost is OFF).
Flags are set when W12 handled the message; a missing booking link or an unapproved template is logged, not silently skipped.

parameters.content:
## SECTION W7 — OUTCOME CHECK-IN
**Starts from:** W7 – Every hour (cron 20 * * * *). **Sends through:** W7 – Call 'W12 - WhatsApp send' (template `outcome_check`, or free text inside the 24 h window).
**Per clinic:** Settings > outcome_checkin = on (missing = off). A **Completed** visit that ended 20-72 h ago (Config: after_hours / max_hours) -> "How are you feeling now? Reply better, the same or worse; tell us if you want another appointment." One per patient; none if a check-in went in the last 7 days, a future visit is Booked, a person owns the conversation (Needs_Human / Assigned_To) or the patient said not interested / STOP.
**Guards:** Opted_Out, Automation_Paused, valid phone, quiet hours 21:00-08:00 IST, TEST_MODE (-> TEST_PHONE), sent flag **Appointments.Outcome_Sent** (new DateTime column) claimed BEFORE the send: a failed claim sends nothing (W11 alerts); one attempt per visit, every attempt in Run_Log (W7-outcome-nudge).
**The answer** comes in through W2 and W13 (Messages.Intent / Conversations.Last_Intent = outcome_better / outcome_same / outcome_worse): better = a short thank-you; same / worse = a person (worse = HIGH, medical, no advice by message); urgent words = URGENT hand-off; "book me again" = the normal Cal.com booking path.

## SECTION W8 — REVIEW REQUEST
**Starts from:** W8 – Every hour (cron 35 * * * *). **Sends through:** W8 – Call 'W12 - WhatsApp send' (template `review_request`, or free text inside the 24 h window).
**Per clinic:** Settings > review_requests = on (missing = off). A **Completed** visit that ended 3 h-7 days ago (Config) -> "we would be grateful for your honest review here: <Settings > review_link> Thank you!". One per patient per 90 days (min_days_between). Same message for everyone: no filtering by mood, outcome or complaints (Google: no review gating), no incentives, no pressure.
**Guards:** Opted_Out, Automation_Paused, valid phone, quiet hours, TEST_MODE, sent flag **Appointments.Review_Sent** claimed BEFORE the send (one attempt per visit, Run_Log W8-review-request).
**No review_link** (or not https://): nothing is sent; at 10:00 IST (config_warning_hour) a Run_Log row (Outcome skipped) says how many requests are waiting. A link is never invented.

## SECTION W9 — WEEKLY REPORT
**Starts from:** W9 – Monday 09:00 (cron 0 9 * * 1), for the week Monday-Sunday that just ended (IST).
**Numbers: code only** (W9 – Metrics, from LEADS, Appointments, Conversations, Messages, Run_Log). **AI: one OpenRouter call per clinic** (W9 – Ask Model, the "OpenRouter API" credential, the model in Config) writes ONLY the summary, observations and recommendations from those numbers; W9 – Report drops any AI line that quotes a number not in the data. No answer = the report is written from the numbers alone.
**7 sections:** executive summary, leads, appointments, AI / hand-offs, follow-ups, important issues, recommended actions (labelled as suggestions, not facts).
**Saved in Run_Log** (Workflow W9-weekly-report, Record = the report). **Owner WhatsApp** (template `weekly_owner_report` to Settings > owner_phone, through W12, once per week): per clinic, OFF until Settings > weekly_report_whatsapp = on (after Meta approves the template).

## SECTION W10 — STAFF REPLY FROM THE GRIST INBOX
**Starts from:** W10 – Every minute. **Sends through:** W10 – Call 'W12 - WhatsApp send' (free text: only inside WhatsApp's 24 h window).
**Staff:** in the Inbox, add a Messages row in the patient's conversation: Direction = Out, Body = the reply, Template empty, then tick **Send**. Only rows with Send ticked are touched.
**Checks** (else the reason goes in AI_Reason, Status failed / needs_template, Send unticked; fix and tick again): body, conversation, valid phone, Opted_Out, 24 h window, TEST_MODE (-> TEST_PHONE). Quiet hours: it waits and goes at 08:00. Automation_Paused / Needs_Human / Assigned_To do not stop a person's reply and are never changed.
**No double send:** the row is claimed first (Send unticked, Status queued); then Status sent + WA_Message_ID (or failed + reason), Conversations.Unread = 0, Run_Log W10-staff-reply. W13 stays out of a conversation for 24 h after a staff message.

## SECTION W11 — ERROR HANDLER
**Source:** "W11 - Error alert" (old id bzsRGJqIW1xcM9eQ). **Starts from:** Error Trigger: any failed production run of THIS workflow

Runs only when another run of this workflow FAILS (production runs, not editor test runs). Telegram alert with workflow, step (node name = module), trimmed error. Same failure at most once per 10 min.
No loop: n8n never starts the error run again when the error run itself fails.

## W11 - Error alert (Telegram)
This workflow contains the Error Trigger, so n8n runs it for failures of the whole workflow (all sections).
The alert holds only the workflow name, step, a trimmed error and a link: no patient data. The same failure alerts at most once per 10 minutes.
**Set up:** credential "FlowHQ Telegram Alerts" (bot token) and FLOWHQ_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. Without a chat id no alert is sent (the failure is still in the execution list).

## SECTION W12 — WHATSAPP SEND ENGINE
**Starts from:** Execute Workflow Trigger (called by W1 / W3 / W4 / W5 / W6 / W7 / W8 / W9 / W10 / W13, one item per call) + Manual test

The ONE place that talks to Meta: decision from the caller -> send_mode allowlist / live -> template check (no hello_world) -> quiet hours -> **consent gate** -> **send ledger claim** -> Meta call (15 s, no retry) -> classification (accepted / rejected / uncertain) -> ledger result -> Grist inbox log.

## W12 - WhatsApp send (reusable sub-workflow)
Other sections call it with **Execute Workflow** (mode: each). It sends ONE approved template or one free-text reply (inside the 24 h window) and returns the caller's item plus:
sent - uncertain - duplicate - idem_key - send_status - wa_message_id - send_error - send_error_code - send_http_status - inbox_logged - inbox_error.
send_status: accepted (sent) | rejected (not sent, may be tried again) | **uncertain** (no clear answer: it may have been delivered; NEVER re-sent automatically, NOT reported as sent) | duplicate (this idem_key was already handled) | blocked / invalid / not_requested (Meta was not called).
**Safety:** idempotency key required; a ledger row (Send_Ledger) is claimed BEFORE Meta is called; a business-initiated template to a patient needs LEADS.Consent_WhatsApp; hello_world is refused; quiet hours 21:00-08:00 IST block every send.
**Environment:** FLOWHQ_WA_SEND_MODE (allowlist | live | off; start with allowlist), FLOWHQ_WA_ALLOWLIST, FLOWHQ_WA_GRAPH_VERSION, FLOWHQ_WA_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE.
**Test:** edit "Test input" (phone number id, doc id, your number) and Execute workflow. Delivery receipts (W2) update the ledger and Messages.Status.

## SECTION FUTURE — RESERVED FOR NEW MODULES
W13, W14, W15, AI receptionist, AI lead qualification, payments, review automation, analytics, staff notifications, new clinic modules.

Rules for a new module:
1. Its own trigger (webhook path or schedule) and its own section sticky; never chain sections together.
2. Name nodes "W<n> – <name>"; Code-node references must use those names.
3. Start with a Config node and read the Agency Registry (never hard-code a clinic).
4. WhatsApp only through the W12 engine (see SECTION 00). Guards, TEST_MODE and sent flags as in CLAUDE.md.
5. Errors reach W11 automatically (same workflow).

## SECTION 00 — MASTER / ENTRY POINTS (production candidate)
**FlowHQ Clinic Automation runs as ONE workflow.** Every trigger below starts only its own section. Sections are not chained.
This export is **inactive**. Read DEPLOYMENT.md, create the credentials (scripts/create-credentials.js), set the FLOWHQ_* environment variables, run scripts/migrate-grist.js, test in Mailpit/allowlist mode, then activate.

- **W1 – Webhook** — POST /webhook/website-lead (n8n Header Auth) -> SECTION W1
- **W2 – Webhook Verify / Inbound** — GET + POST /webhook/whatsapp-inbound (Meta; POST needs a valid X-Hub-Signature-256) -> SECTION W2
- **W3 – Every 10 minutes** -> SECTION W3 (speed to lead)
- **W4 – Webhook1** — POST /webhook/cal?clinic=<slug> (Cal.com, HMAC over the raw body) -> SECTION W4
- **W5 – Every 15 minutes** -> SECTION W5 (reminders)
- **W6 – Daily 10:00** -> SECTION W6 (follow-ups)
- **W7 / W8 – Every hour** -> outcome check-in / review request
- **W9 – Monday 09:00** -> weekly report (AI text only if FLOWHQ_AI_EXTERNAL_ENABLED=true)
- **W10 – Every minute** -> staff reply from the Grist inbox
- **W11 – Error Trigger** -> Telegram alert (needs FLOWHQ_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID)
- **W12 – When called by another workflow** -> the ONE WhatsApp sender (send ledger, consent gate, quiet hours, TEST_MODE)
- **W14 – Every 15 minutes** -> send-ledger reconcile

**Secrets and settings** are never stored in this file: Config nodes read FLOWHQ_* environment variables, credentials are n8n credentials.
**WhatsApp:** only SECTION W12 calls Meta. A message needs idem_key (or booking_uid / inbox_row_id / message_row_id / week), an approved template and a decision from the caller's send guard.
**Missed-call capture is NOT part of this workflow** (no telephony provider is connected): see MISSED_CALL.md.

parameters.content:
## W2 – WhatsApp Inbound
Meta WhatsApp Cloud API -> n8n -> the clinic's Grist CRM. Sends nothing by itself (a reply, if any, is W13 -> W12).
**Webhook:** GET + POST /webhook/whatsapp-inbound. The POST must carry a valid X-Hub-Signature-256 (App Secret = FLOWHQ_META_APP_SECRET): otherwise 401 and nothing is read or written. The GET handshake uses FLOWHQ_META_VERIFY_TOKEN.
Delivery receipts (sent / delivered / read / failed) arrive on the same URL: they update Send_Ledger and Messages.Status.
Duplicates (same WA_Message_ID) change nothing. A patient who starts the chat is recorded with Consent_Source whatsapp-inbound (FLOWHQ_W2_IMPLIED_CONSENT=false turns that off). STOP opts the patient out (no AI needed).

## SECTION A — META WEBHOOK VERIFY (GET)
Meta calls this once when you save the webhook. It sends hub.mode, hub.verify_token and hub.challenge. The token must match "W2 – Verify Config"; then the challenge is echoed back as plain text. A wrong or unconfigured token answers 403.

## SECTION B — INBOUND POST + MANUAL TEST
Meta POST (or the manual test data) -> Config -> Parse. Webhook calls are answered right away (200 for anything Meta-shaped, 400 for garbage), then processing continues. Delivery receipts and other events are ignored. Messages are processed ONE AT A TIME.

## SECTION C — CLINIC, PHONE, DUPLICATE CHECK
phone_number_id -> Agency Registry Clinics (Active must be TRUE) -> unknown / inactive clinic stops here. Sender -> +91XXXXXXXXXX. Same WA_Message_ID already in Messages = duplicate: nothing is created.

## SECTION D — LEAD
Find the lead by normalized phone; if none, create one (Source WhatsApp, Status New, Lead_id L-YYYYMMDD-NNNN). After creating, look again: parallel messages from one new patient converge on the lowest row id.

## SECTION E — CONVERSATION
Find the conversation by normalized phone; if none, create it (Phone + Lead). After creating, look again: parallel messages converge on the lowest row id.

## SECTION F — MESSAGE, STAFF ALERT PAYLOAD, RUN_LOG
Add the Messages row (Direction In, WA_Message_ID), then update Last_Inbound_At / Unread (Automation_Paused and Assigned_To are never touched). A new lead prepares a staff-alert payload for W12 (decision.send = false: NOT sent from here). Every message ends in one Run_Log row: ok, skipped (duplicate, bad number) or failed (with the reason). A failing Run_Log write ends quietly: no retries, no loops.

## SECTION FUTURE — AFTER THE MERGE
W12 (the one WhatsApp sender) is the only planned integration point: route the staff-alert payload through a guard node (owner phone, TEST_MODE, quiet hours) and "Call W12". Not done here on purpose.

## W2 → AI RECEPTIONIST
Only a message that W2 **stored** (not a duplicate, status event, invalid payload, unknown clinic or failed Grist write) starts ONE AI job: this workflow is called again with `w13_job = true` (no waiting) and "W12 – AI Job?" sends it to SECTION W13. W2 then logs to Run_Log exactly as before.

## SECTION W13 — AI RECEPTIONIST (OpenRouter)
**Entry:** "W12 – AI Job?" (items with `w13_job` from W2, or `w13_retry` from the 08:05 run) and **W13 – Every Morning** (08:05: messages deferred overnight). One message per execution.

**Does:** reads clinic, Settings, Knowledge, the message, conversation, lead, history, Booked appointments → safety gates (handled, STOP, ai_mode, opted out, paused, Needs_Human, answered, newer message, night, media, rate limit) → marks the message `processing` → OpenRouter (Provider Request → Ask Model → Provider Answer) → **W13 – Plan** checks the JSON decision (schema, confidence ≥ 0.7, complaint/payment/medical → person, fact check of prices / times / links) → appointment writes → **W12** (this workflow, the only WhatsApp sender) → CRM writes + Run_Log.

**Fill after import:** credential **OpenRouter API** on `W13 – Ask Model`. **Switch on per clinic:** Settings `ai_mode` = draft / auto (missing = off). Dry runs: use the standalone "W13 DEMO" workflow (Manual Test).

## SECTION W14 — SEND-LEDGER RECONCILE
**Starts from:** Schedule: every 15 minutes

For every ACTIVE clinic: ledger rows still "sending" after 15 minutes become "uncertain"; "uncertain" rows with no delivery receipt after 24 hours become "unconfirmed". Nothing is ever re-sent. Each change is a failed Run_Log row (Workflow `W14-send-ledger`): look there after an outage.

Delivery receipts (W2) settle ledger rows by themselves and win over this job.
